descriptions.inProgress: #p1102007#, after telling you about acquiring items from boxes, has asked that you collect a #b#t4032267##k and a #b#t4032268##k from the boxes scattered around the field. He says you can only break the boxes using #bRegular Attacks#k.
descriptions.completed: Upon receiving a #t4032267# and a #t4032268#, #p1102007# made you a fantastic chair using the materials. If you continue to your left, you'll meet the last brother, #p1102008#. Let's rush over.
